text:
A behemoth among its meager lineage, the goliarch prowls the deep using its feeder limbs to grasp and pull anything it can into 
its needle-toothed maw. Often found drifting along the surface listlessly, preserving energy, only until its abyssal black eyes spot a 
glimmer of life in those darkened depths does it explode into ferocious motion. Dozens of paddle-shaped limbs churn the water as it 
barges into coral and stone alike to latch its many bladed maxilliped into a prey's flesh to feast. When the rare occurrence of a whale 
fall happening near the shores of Sol’Kesh, they converge upon them in fi erce masses of savage hunger, often cannibalizing their own 
as much as feasting on the fallen cetacean in a mad frenzy.

Surface Scavenger Th e goliarch can breathe only underwater, but 
may hold its breath out of water for 10 minutes.
Hidden Horror Th e goliarch can take the Hide action as a Bonus 
action. Additionally, the goliarch makes Dexterity (Stealth) checks 
with Advantage if there is loose underwater sediment within 5 ft. 
of it that it can bury itself under.
Ravenous (3/Day) After hitting a creature with an Eviscerate 
attack, the goliarch gains 8 (2d4 + 3) temporary Hit Points and 
becomes immune to the Frightened condition for 1 minute.

Mindless Aggression Th e goliarch can move up to its speed 
towards a hostile creature that it can see.
Encountering If a traveler approaches cautiously and unseen 
while the goliarch waits along the bottom of the ocean floor, 
one may be able to escape its notice or attack it unawares. Th e 
crustacean do not have specifi ed hunting grounds and tend to 
roam widely, so it is not uncommon for more than one of these 
non-territorial, savage crustaceans to attack the same prey.

Multiattack Th e goliarch makes three attacks, using Needling 
Bite, Puncturing Claw and Eviscerate in any combination.
Needling Bite Melee Attack Roll: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 
Hit: 10 (3d4 + 3) Piercing damage.
Puncturing Claw Melee Attack Roll: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one 
target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage. Strength Saving Th row:
DC 14, target creature that was hit by two or more Puncturing 
Claw Attacks. Failure: Target creature has the Grappled 
condition (Escape DC 14). If the goliarch Grapples a creature in 
this way then it loses one of its Puncturing Claw attacks until 
the creature escapes the goliarch’s Grapple.
Eviscerate Melee Weapon Roll: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 
Hit: 25 (5d8 + 3) Slashing damage. Constitution Saving Th row: DC 
12, target creature the goliarch has successful hit. Failure: Target 
creature’s max health is temporarily decreased by half the 
damage dealt by this attack, until the target takes a Long Rest.
Bonus Actions
Each maxilliped ends with razored filament 
bristles that not only grip and pull in large 
prey, but subtly collect stray particulates from 
the water to feed the prawn in a form of passive 
filter feeding while it calmly floats in wait
Resting within the sands to 
await prey, to the untrained eye 
the goliarch looks to be nothing 
more than a large sunken stone 
Segmented chitin provides 
the prawn a durable shell, 
yet besides the ability to 
turn its head, it affords 
very little lateral direction 
when swimming quickly 
Though a paltry meal, the fleeing 
arrow-shaped taddil sea slug 
stands little chance of escaping 
the voracious goliarch
